summary: End-to-end test of TomeForge MVP (frontend + backend). AI text (Gemini 3 Flash) and AI image (Gemini Nano Banana + Emergent object storage) are the primary AI features — both PASS with real outputs. All 13 backend pytest cases pass; full UI flow (login -> collection -> AI create -> card detail -> flip -> share PNG -> PDF F/R -> delete) works. Monster stat block and Character spell slots (plus/minus/long rest) + A4 PDF sheet all working. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm, ai-testing-image-video.
ai_feature_verdicts: AI text generation (Gemini 3 Flash) - pass - evidence: POST /api/ai/generate-content 200 in ~10s; returned name='Statua del Gelo Eterno', desc=321 chars, story=319 chars, attributes with livello/scuola/tempo_lancio/gittata/componenti/durata/effetto all populated in Italian. Monster prompt returned classe_armatura, punti_ferita, for/des/cos filled (D&D-appropriate). skill: ai-testing-llm

AI image generation (Gemini Nano Banana) [PRIMARY visual] - pass - evidence: POST /api/ai/generate-image 200 -> artwork_path=tomeforge/artwork/user_1a6451f0fadf/*.jpg; GET /api/files/<path> with Bearer -> 200, JPEG bytes with FFD8FF header, size > 5KB. Auth-required (401 without token, 200 with ?auth= query). skill: ai-testing-image-video
Emergent Object Storage - pass - evidence: upload (1x1 PNG) -> tomeforge/uploads/<user>/*.png, retrieved back with PNG signature. Used by both generate-image and /api/upload.

issues: Sonner success toast appears in top-center and can briefly overlap the NUOVA CARTA button in navbar right after login (~2s). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file 501 lines - acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/cards.py, routers/ai.py, services/storage.py once feature set grows.
generate_content: on JSONDecodeError, `text` local var can be undefined if the exception fires before assignment path (edge case if raw.strip() returns empty). Defensive but low risk.
download route: no rate limiting on /api/files/{path} - fine for MVP but public preview endpoint may want throttling long-term.
html2canvas triggers CORS on remote Unsplash images used as placeholder artwork - works with useCORS: true today but PDF/PNG export could break if the CDN changes headers. Not blocking.

AI image test consumes 1 real generation (~5-10s). Cleanup logic deletes all TEST_-prefixed cards. Frontend has data-testid on every interactive element per Landing/Collection/CardEditor/CardDetail. File input is intentionally hidden and driven via upload-btn (use set_input_files with state='attached' or default state, not 'visible').
